deployment: Backend before new KMP; legacy installed clients retain envelopes and query-token socket auth.

http.success: Existing message/data envelope; empty/204, raw resources and existing paginated APIs retain their own shape.
http.pagination: messages by descending integer ID; rooms by descending updated_at, UUID; room cursor signed/actor-bound/900s expiry; invalid cursor 400
http.retry: Bounded opt-in GET/HEAD. No automatic write replay. auth-1 refresh: single-flight, stable request_id; replay same rotation for 60s only.

websocket.authentication: Bearer header preferred; legacy token query adapter; native clients omit Origin, browsers allowlisted.
websocket.ack: success request_id after service transaction returns; ack loss is ambiguous and must not auto-replay.
websocket.event_delivery: At-most observed bounded client dedupe by event_id; events can be lost, duplicated, reordered. Content-free socket hints trigger catch-up; HTTP snapshot recovery runs on reconnect, foreground, or explicit manual recovery.
websocket.subscription: fetch_messages or subscribe_room subscribes; unsubscribe_room removes; disconnect removes all; max20 rooms per connection.
websocket.limits: 64KiB command,30 burst/10 per second per connection,4000 text,10 media,50 page items. Not distributed abuse protection.
websocket.unknown: Ignore unknown fields; unknown/malformed events invalidate snapshots; unsupported commands receive unknown_action.

authentication.legacy_cutoff: AUTH_ACCEPT_LEGACY_TOKENS must be explicitly disabled after announced rollout; no automatic invalidation during migration.
authentication.otp: Server-managed Twilio Messaging; HMAC protected, 5 min expiry, 5 attempts, 60s resend, 3 sends/phone/10min, database source/global spend reservations.
authentication.profile: Incremental name then upload or explicit skip; completed legacy accounts retained. No automatic couple creation.

couple_profile.visibility: Authenticated viewers receive only sections approved by both current partners for exact content and membership. Either partner can revoke immediately.
couple_profile.conflict: PATCH sections require expected_revision from that viewer projection. Stale section -> 409 section_changed; different sections/author story contributions do not overwrite each other.
couple_profile.media: First-party authenticated guarded URLs; private no-store; uploaded covers under couples/profile_private must not be served by a public bucket/proxy. Moment references retain original audience and expiry.
couple_profile.chat: Optional server-authored profile_action on chat message: kind story or plan, couple_id, prompt or plan_id. No client flags confer access.
couple_profile.rollout: Additive social 0011-0013 and chat 0003 migrations, backend first, then KMP. Legacy routes retained; cover URLs now require authenticated delivery, including old profile_photos paths. Block private prefixes at any proxy/bucket. No deployment is implied.
